items.description:
Sheriff Pretoria South West is a sheriff's office on Iron Terrace in West Park, handling court document service and execution across its Pretoria South West jurisdiction. Its listed services include summons and legal notice service, warrant execution, attachment and seizure of assets, eviction notices and execution, debt collection document service and commercial litigation support, along with property attachment proceedings.

As a statutory office rather than a private firm, it acts under the courts and must follow South African legal process at every step, from confirming the right sheriff for an address to delivering the documents. The office's page on Sheriff Flow lets clients enter a service address on an interactive map to find the sheriff for that area, and courier deliveries are booked through The Courier Guy. It suits attorneys, creditors and members of the public who need a document served or a court order carried out in the West Park area of Pretoria.

items.reason: Goodfirms page loaded but describes an unrelated software firm (Acme Studio); bestdirectory page timed out. Deeper research since raises a serious identity issue: the SA company "Sherlock Data Recovery Services" is recorded as inactive/deregistered (registered address 483 Ohio Street, Faerie Glen, matching older listings), and the currently-accessible sherlockdatarecovery.com actually belongs to an unrelated New York company. Verify current trading status and identity before publishing; kept deferred.

items.description:
SITA SOC Ltd is South Africa's state-owned information technology agency, established in 1999 to consolidate and coordinate the state's IT resources. It provides network hosting, end-user computing, application development and maintenance, architecture and standards, security and service management to government departments, along with ERP, e-government and GovTech work.

The agency also runs the procurement channels through which government buys software, hardware and transversal contracts, and it publishes its corporate governance structures, strategic plans and annual reports. Its Erasmuskloof office in Pretoria is part of a national footprint that includes provincial management structures. It is a reference point for public-sector technology buyers and for suppliers who want to bid on state IT work.

Sol-Tech is a private vocational training college in Monument Park, Pretoria, offering Afrikaans-medium, skills-based training for the trades and the workplace. Its courses include engineering fitting and machining through the Pas-en-Draai qualification, an information technology practitioner programme with individual certifications, a bridging programme and hairdressing, alongside technical trades training.

The college describes a three-phase model that pairs theory with practical work in its workshops and then in-service training. It reports that 77 percent of its students find work within a month of qualifying, and its campus offers hostel accommodation. It suits school-leavers and adults who want a practical qualification taught in Afrikaans, and the campus is at Duinlewerik Street in Monument Park.

Solar Hub SA is a solar energy and financing company based at Roodepark Eco Estate in Kameeldrift, Pretoria, building solar systems for businesses without large upfront costs. Its offering includes zero-capex power purchase agreements, where a client pays only for the energy the system produces at a rate below the grid, along with off-site wheeling for businesses whose rooftops are unsuitable, operating leases and rent-to-own options.

The company says it manages the regulatory work from start to finish, including SSEG registration, NERSA approvals and Eskom compliance, and that its funders typically include insurance, 24/7 monitoring and long-term maintenance in the service fee. It is aimed at businesses that want to cut electricity costs and protect operations against load shedding, and it offers a free feasibility study as the first step.

Stage Effects is a technical event production and rental company in Samcor Park, Derdepoort, supplying staging, lighting and LED equipment along with the technical crews to run it. Its site describes a comprehensive range of specialised equipment and more than 18 years of experience in event staging.

The company's event work includes road shows, year-end functions, conferencing, exhibitions, seminars, corporate dinners, product launches, award evenings, music festivals and private functions. Its brand is built on being unpretentious and hands-on, with a team that gets involved to make each event look its best. It suits event planners, corporate clients and festival organisers who need dependable equipment and people on site, and it operates from Propshaft Road in Pretoria.

Stanrio Pipe and Steel is a steel merchant in Silverton, Pretoria, established in 1979 and supplying steel tubing, angle iron, flat bar, channels, IPE beams and columns, galvanised and hot-rolled sheeting, roof sheeting, treadplate and stainless and aluminium sections. Its range also includes plates from 5mm and up, reinforcing, expanded metal, welded mesh, palisade fencing, sliding gates and razor wire, plus hardware such as gate motors and welding consumables.

In-house CNC plasma cutting handles mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium from 1.2mm up to 16mm, including holes and special profile designs. The company also sells offcuts and aluminium and stainless profiles by the metre, and it cuts and delivers orders. Its customers range from large contractors to DIY enthusiasts looking for custom steel work. It is at 280 Dykor Street in Silverton.

Starbright is a full-service digital marketing agency in Pretoria, covering web design and development, custom web applications and SaaS platforms, SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing, graphic design and UX design. Its website work ranges from WordPress sites to high-converting e-commerce stores, and its site presents a set of recent projects as examples of the work.

The agency plans its channels together, so web design, SEO and paid search bring visitors to a site while social media, copywriting and email marketing encourage them to return. It targets South African businesses that want online visibility and growth from one coordinated strategy rather than isolated services. Its office is at Sovereign Drive in Route 21 Business Park, Pretoria.

Stephnie's is a restaurant at Lynnwood Bridge in Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria, presenting itself as a culinary theatre. Diners on its site describe a menu that runs from a Sunday roast special and fig and camembert starters to a 300g sirloin steak and chicken with figs, dates and mozzarella, and the kitchen will adapt starters for vegans while still catering for meat-eaters.

The room is described as aesthetically pleasing and quiet enough for intimate conversations, and guests mention good service and an Irish coffee among the drinks. The site also lists a gallery and functions and events. It suits couples, small groups and diners who want a long lunch or an evening out with a mixed-diet group, and the restaurant is in Shop 7 at Lynnwood Bridge on Daventry Street.

Synercore is a South African food-ingredient and formulation group that supports manufacturers across dairy, beverages, bakery, culinary, meat, soya and grain sectors with product development, reformulation and upscaling. Its work combines research, technical formulation expertise and specialised ingredient supply, delivered through five specialist divisions, including African Food Industries, which builds customised ingredient solutions with end-to-end new-product support.

The group describes itself as an innovation and development partner rather than only an ingredient supplier, and it reports customers across sub-Saharan Africa and threefold export growth across the continent. Its site marks a decade of impact and focuses on applied science and practical food solutions. The Hermanstad site at Steyns Industrial Park on Van Riebeeck Road suits food manufacturers looking for a technical partner to turn an idea into a commercial product.

The Bushbaby Inn is a guesthouse in Lydiana, Pretoria, offering individual guest rooms with their own private accommodation facilities for overnight stays. It is listed as a guest house in the city's business directories, with each room let separately rather than as shared accommodation, so visitors have their own private space for the length of their stay.

It suits travellers who want guesthouse accommodation rather than a large hotel, whether for a short stay, a business trip or leisure travel in Pretoria, and the property is consistently rated highly by the guests who have stayed there. The Bushbaby Inn is at 11 Suikerbos Drive in Lydiana, Pretoria, and takes bookings directly for guests looking for a smaller, more personal place to stay.

The Decisionsmiths is a decision-intelligence consultancy that combines data analytics, behavioural science and psychology-aware AI to help organisations make better decisions. Its work covers diagnostic assessments, data intelligence platforms and AI-assisted decision tools, aimed at empowering teams to decide faster and with higher quality.

The firm treats decision-making as a mix of data, human biology and organisational culture rather than a dashboard problem. It was founded by a process analyst with 25 years of multi-industry experience and a PhD in decision-making behaviour, who has led engineering teams of about fifty people and consults for international firms. Its site also lists a forthcoming book and a focus on managing cognitive load and stress resilience. It suits organisations whose strategic initiatives underdeliver despite heavy investment in data, and it is based in Lydiana, Pretoria.

The Echelon Group is a multinational advisory, consultancy, investment and business-development firm that helps take projects from early stages into flourishing ventures. Its services include project planning and implementation, technical and feasibility studies, baseline and social research, project and programme monitoring and evaluation, local revenue mobilisation, business process re-engineering, institutional reviews and social investment.

The firm says it has advised multinationals, national and provincial governments, municipalities and parastatals on strategy development, change management, revenue optimisation and market intelligence. Its founder brought a background in enterprise resource planning and change leadership from large corporates, and the firm says it handles complex, highly confidential projects. The business is based in Centurion, at Mnandi Road in the Glen Lauriston area.

The Facilitators is a one-stop NHBRC service provider that handles registrations, renewals, enrolments, exemptions and amendments between home builders, developers and the National Home Builders Registration Council. It states that it has worked with the NHBRC since the council started and claims the largest team of any facilitator for these applications.

Its published prices start at R2 500 for a registration, completed within two weeks, R875 for a renewal within two weeks, and R1 850 for an enrolment of a home or development within two to three weeks. An exemption from enrolment is quoted from R1 850 and takes about six weeks. After a quote is paid, the team submits the application and passes the NHBRC invoice on, so the builder does not have to manage the paperwork. It is based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion.

The Queen Pet Shop at Nina Park Square stocks food, treats and supplies for dogs, cats, small animals, reptiles, birds and fish. Its dog and cat ranges cover dry and wet food, treats, toys, beds, collars, leads and harnesses, grooming and hygiene products, and medication and supplements, and it carries premium brands such as Hill's Science Plan and Royal Canin.

Hill's is presented as vet-recommended, science-backed nutrition with formulas for each breed, age and diet, while Royal Canin ranges from grain-free to breed-specific formulas. The site also lists promotions on reptile heat rocks and durable nylon chews, and it sorts products by animal so owners can find what they need quickly. It suits pet owners who want tailored nutrition as well as everyday accessories for several animals, and the shop is on Grafenheim Street in Ninapark, Pretoria.

The South African Creative Industries Incubator, known as SACII, is a turnkey, township-based creative hub in Eersterust, Pretoria. It offers business and arts incubation, acceleration, technical skills training, and production facilities and equipment for creative-economy entrepreneurs and small businesses, with accredited skills training and separate services for corporates.

The incubator says it has worked in the creative SMME environment for about eight years, with a focus on creative industries, and that it has partnered with government and private-sector entities to deliver tailored incubation programmes. Its mission is to support sustainable creative SMMEs through business and vocational training, market development and shared economic facilities. It suits young creatives and township entrepreneurs who need equipment, training and a route to market, and it is based at Perry Avenue in Eersterust.

The Specialists Franchise Group head office in Die Hoewes, Centurion, coordinates a network of more than 70 owner-managed branches providing pest control, cleaning and washroom hygiene services. The group was established in 1978 and works through three divisions covering pest control, cleaning and hygiene, with hygiene products also available.

Its model is that customers are answered directly by the owner-managed branch nearest them rather than by a call centre, with a response within one business day and an obligation-free assessment on request. The group is FASA, SAPCA and NCCA registered and publishes a branch directory covering South Africa and neighbouring countries. It suits homes and businesses that want accountable local service from a team that stands behind the result.

Thinkroom Consulting is an SME development consultancy working with African startups and small businesses. It collaborates with large corporations and development organisations to identify opportunities for SMEs across the continent, and its offering is grouped into Thinkroom services, the Thinkubate programme, go-to-market strategy, and the Grindstone accelerator and ventures arms.

The firm was founded in 2014 with a focus on quality consulting for corporations and digital tech entrepreneurs. Its stated aim is to connect big business with African SMEs, train and develop them, and then use its networks to take them to market. The founder is also managing partner of Grindstone Accelerator and Grindstone Ventures. Its office is at Midlands Office Park in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein.

Tubecon Africa is a steel tube and profile manufacturer established in 1977. It makes round, square and rectangular tubes, scaffold, conveyor, lancing and borehole casing tubes, big-bore welded tube, D-sections and oval tubes, conduit and customised open profiles, and its Tubecon Laser arm adds tube laser cutting and plate laser cutting and bending.

The company runs a manufacturing facility in Pretoria and a branch in Cape Town, and its own truck fleet supplies Gauteng and Cape Town daily, with Durban, Pietermaritzburg and Bloemfontein served more than once a week. It also supplies Namibia, Botswana and Mozambique. It suits industrial buyers who want a steel supplier that handles quoting, delivery and after-sales service, and the business is based at Piet Rautenbach Street in Rosslyn, Pretoria.

Turner Morris is a South African industrial equipment supplier and manufacturer founded in 1936. It sells construction, agricultural, survey and cleaning equipment, generators and inverter generators, power and hand tools, lawn and garden equipment, handling equipment and solar and home-energy systems, along with spare parts and services.

The company says its products are designed to last in African conditions and that its factory in Johannesburg manufactures a range of its own equipment. It also acts as agent and distributor for products imported from suppliers across five continents, and it has its own branches in South Africa and outlets in southern Africa. This Silverton branch on Pretoria Road suits contractors, farmers and homeowners who need equipment, parts or advice on whether to hire or buy.

Typewrite Office Equipment is a stationery and office-equipment supplier in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, trading since 1980. Its shop sells laser printer cartridges, ink cartridges, Trodat self-inking and rubber stamps, credit card machine rolls, stationery and office equipment from brands including Brother, Canon, Epson, HP, Samsung and Novaro.

The range runs from wireless and wired mouse and keyboard combinations to a Brother ScanNCut home and hobby cutting machine. The company says it has supplied office solutions for over 40 years and promotes unmatched service and satisfaction. It suits offices and home businesses that need stamps, cartridges or basic office equipment, and the shop is on Steve Biko Road in Wonderboom South.

Unahina Business Solutions is a contract-based funding provider in Menlo Park, Pretoria, offering purchase order funding, tender funding and invoice discounting to South African businesses that need working capital to deliver awarded tenders and confirmed orders. Its purchase order funding can cover up to 100 percent of verified supplier costs, and its invoice discounting is advertised at 80 percent of the invoice value.

Tender funding can cover materials, labour, mobilisation costs and supplier payments before milestone payments arrive, which suits businesses working for government departments, municipalities, construction projects and corporate clients. The company advertises a turnaround of two to five business days and offers a conversation with a specialist before applying. It is based in Building 210 at Pegasus on Amarand Avenue, Menlo Park.

items.reason: Own site loaded only a short overview (four digital billboards in Pretoria, Astute Business Solutions as a subsidiary). Deeper research confirms only the directory's own address (Shop 12, Montana Value Centre, 1141 Tecomaria Street, Montana Park); no reliable source establishes UniNetwork's specific construction-industry services. Hold/verify; kept deferred, not enough for a sourced 100+ word description without padding.

items.description:
Venter and Geldenhuys Incorporated is a Pretoria law firm specialising in commercial law and business litigation, with practice areas that also include family law, criminal law, business rescue, personal injury, labour law and insolvency law. It handles High Court and Magistrates' Court litigation, and its website lists each service in full.

The firm's blog covers current legal issues, including the Tobacco Products and Electronic Delivery Systems Control Bill and the meaning of exceptional circumstances in bail applications for Schedule 6 offences. Prospective clients can request a case evaluation, which the firm says it provides within 24 hours, or schedule a consultation. It suits businesses that need counsel on contracts, disputes or rescue proceedings, and the office is in the Waterkloofrand Centre on Rigel Avenue in Erasmusrand, Pretoria.

Venture Otto SA operates as part of the Venture Global group, active in automotive component manufacturing as well as engineering and construction, renewable energy, aircraft building and refurbishment, industrial and commercial cleaning, and high-tech modular housing. Its work spans several specialised technical and manufacturing disciplines rather than a single product line.

The company serves automotive, engineering, construction, industrial, renewable-energy and other commercial sectors that need manufacturing capacity or specialised technical services, and states it was established in 1997. Venture Otto SA trades from The Boardwalk at 75 Eros Road in Faerie Glen, Pretoria East, forming the South African presence of a wider Venture Global group that also operates in Australia, China and India.

Vetceuticals is a veterinary wholesaler in Roodeplaat, Pretoria, distributing animal-health products for small-scale livestock farmers. Its range runs from pet and farm-animal lines to wildlife, with categories for small animals, equine, cattle, sheep and poultry, and its warehousing and distribution operation serves customers across the country.

The company describes itself as operating ethically within statutory guidelines, with links to SAHPRA, the South African Pharmacy Council, the national Department of Health and the South African Veterinary Council. Deliveries are handled through partnered courier services, and it draws on qualified specialists in their fields. Through the U-Farm initiative, IT professionals and veterinarians build mobile applications and hardware for livestock farmers in rural areas. It suits small-scale livestock farmers who need affordable, reliable products, and the business is on Leeuwfontein Road in Roodeplaat.

Vision Group Consulting is an engineering firm at Highveld Techno Park in Centurion. Its services include integrated automation system design, industrial control and optimisation, scalable plant performance, complex environment solutions, real-time monitoring and control, SCADA platform integration and robotics, for industrial plants and their operators.

The firm's current work includes illumination surveys and high-mast lighting, and electrical commissioning of MV and LV switchgear, motor control, variable speed drives, protection relays and power cables. Its project scopes are mainly for mining and heavy-industrial clients in the Northern Cape, and it is recruiting contract and freelance specialists for those projects. It suits mining and industrial operators who need one engineering partner for automation, commissioning and lighting work, and it is based in Manhattan Office Park on West Avenue.

Vos Consulting is a business and management consultancy offering strategic business planning and implementation, operational efficiency and process optimisation, organisational structure assessment and redesign, and performance-management systems. Its work is built around diagnosing where a business is losing efficiency or clarity and then implementing a plan to fix it, rather than producing a report and moving on.

It serves organisations and businesses that need help setting business strategy, improving day-to-day operations, restructuring how a company is organised, or putting a performance-management system in place so staff and output can be measured consistently. Vos Consulting is based at 12 Parker Street in Riviera, Pretoria, and suits management teams that want practical, hands-on consulting support rather than a large corporate advisory firm.

Vulindlela Financial Services is an authorised financial services provider (FSP 49685) based in the Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate in Centurion. It offers short-term, commercial and long-term insurance solutions, and says that its partnerships with major South African insurers give clients access to the latest products and specialist advice.

The firm is licensed under the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act and says its staff undergo continuous training in giving advice and rendering intermediary services. Its stated values are integrity, prudence and reliability. Enquiries sent through its website receive a response as soon as possible. It suits individuals and businesses who want personalised cover from a licensed adviser, and the office is at Cass de Campo Street in Copperleaf, Centurion.

W. G. Haese & Partners is a professional property and development consultancy operating from Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria. It is a member practice of the South African Association of Consulting Professional Planners, a body representing independent planning and property professionals, and its professional record includes past appointments carrying out property valuation work for clients needing an independent opinion of value.

It serves property owners, developers and other organisations that need professional, planning-related property advice, from valuation through to development-related consulting. W. G. Haese & Partners is based at 48 Ilona Street in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, and suits clients who want an established, professionally affiliated practice for property and development matters.

The Water Research Commission is a South African public research and knowledge organisation focused on water. Its work centres on funding, directing and disseminating research that builds the knowledge the country needs to manage its water resources, water and wastewater services, and water-related sectors.

It serves government departments, municipalities, universities and researchers, and water-sector organisations and industry bodies that rely on its research output and knowledge products. The Water Research Commission's Pretoria office is on the second floor of the building known as the Bloukrans Building, at 4 Daventry Road in Lynnwood Bridge Office Park, Lynnwood Manor, and it functions as a national knowledge hub rather than a water utility itself.

Woodpecker Playgrounds builds and installs custom wooden jungle gyms and outdoor play equipment in Pretoria and Johannesburg, and says it has been doing so for 23 years. Its standard units come in small, medium and large sizes, and designs include platforms with roofs, wheel ramps, log ladders, fireman's poles, commando nets, rope ramps and wheel towers, all built as heavy-duty equipment.

Add-ons include swings for one to eight seaters, wood, tyre and baby seats, heavy-duty fibreglass slides with hose connectors, and sand pits in several sizes, excluding play sand. Custom-designed jungle gyms are available on request, and installation is included in the quoted unit prices. Its customers include creches, nurseries, restaurants and pubs. The workshop and sales base is on Lavender Road in Annlin, Pretoria.

Wrapsa is a pharmaceutical contract manufacturer established in 1983, one of the first third-party pharmaceutical manufacturing and packing operators in South Africa. It runs a GMP-compliant facility in Centurion and offers manufacturing, packaging and laboratory services for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical brands, including custom gummy ranges.

Its services include accepting raw materials and packaging components on a firm or consignment basis, assistance with medicine registration and validation support. The company describes its work as built on flexibility and confidentiality, with a skills base it says is worthy of international recognition. It suits brand owners who need a contract partner to manufacture and pack their products, and the facility is on Bell Crescent in Hennopspark, Centurion.

Xneelo is a South African web hosting provider based in Samrand Business Park, Kosmosdal, Centurion, and says it has been trusted in hosting for more than 25 years. Its services include domain registration, shared web hosting and self-managed servers, with domains from R105 a year and hosting plans from R99 a month.

Hosting plans include unlimited traffic, a free SSL certificate, daily backups and fast SSD storage, and the company advertises 99.9 percent network uptime with 24/7 support. Its options include a Cloudbric web application firewall for added protection against DDoS attacks and malware, and 1 Gbps uplink speeds at its data-centre locations. It suits small businesses and website owners who want a stable host with round-the-clock help, and the office is at Landmarks Avenue in Samrand.

XS Sure specialises in short-term insurance add-on products, including ExcessSure, TyreSure, WindscreenSure, ScratchSure and GeyserSure, along with rim and tyre solutions and homeowners and building-related cover. Its products are underwritten by Guardrisk Insurance Limited and are designed to sit alongside a client's main short-term insurance policy rather than replace it.

It serves insurance intermediaries and members of the public who want supplementary cover for costs a standard policy does not fully pay out, such as an excess, a damaged tyre or windscreen, or a geyser failure. XS Sure is an authorised financial services provider, trading as X's Sure (Pty) Ltd (FSP 21101), established in 2005 and based at 48 Sterling Road in Samrand Business Park, Kosmosdal.

Xyrax is an internet service provider in Thatchfield Estate, Centurion, offering fibre and fixed wireless internet for homes and businesses. Its fixed wireless service reaches homes, farms and businesses beyond the fibre footprint, and its fibre plans are uncapped, with symmetrical options for demanding business connections.

For businesses it also offers VoIP and voice services across desk phones, PBX systems and mobile devices, along with managed firewalls, VPN, surveillance, domains, email and cloud services. Support is provided remotely around the clock, and the company publishes a live network status page for its customers. It has been established since 2018 and suits households and businesses that want a dependable connection with security and telephony handled alongside it. The office is on Jacuna Street in Thatchfield.

Yanga Environmental Services provides waste management, environmental management, asbestos removal, civil works and health and safety services across South Africa. It operates five offices, in Polokwane, Mbombela, Cape Town, Pretoria and Tsolo, and its work covers specialised waste handling as well as environmental compliance.

The Pretoria office is at Parkzicht in Pretoria Central, and the company runs a 24-hour line for spill response, so clients can report an incident at any hour. Office hours are Monday to Friday, and each enquiry is answered with a clear scope and a firm price. It suits industrial, commercial and property clients who need compliance work, asbestos handling or emergency spill response, and the Pretoria office is at Minnaar Street.

Yellow Lemon Media is a visual communications agency based in Highveld, Pretoria, with more than 10 years of experience. Its services include video production, live streaming, photography, graphic design, brand development and awareness, social media management, smart production solutions and real-estate photography and video packages.

The agency says it has delivered more than 700 quotes and covered more than 500 events, and that it works with clients ranging from startups to established enterprises across a range of sectors. Its work spans live events, music videos and brand campaigns. It suits businesses that want one creative partner for video and social content, and the studio is in Unit 5B on Charles de Gaulle Crescent.

items.reason: Only a journalism-site contributor biography about an individual was found, plus the site's 502 error. Deeper research confirms his professional credential (Admitted Advocate of the High Court, practice number 11268, issued July 2005, with previous senior public-sector legal/departmental roles) but not the supplied Murrayfield address or any specific law-practice name or services tied to that address. The confirmed credential cannot be tied to this listing's location/services; kept deferred.

items.description:
Advance Cash n Carry is a wholesale and bulk-grocery retailer selling fast-moving consumer goods, groceries, household products, cosmetics and personal-care products. Its business model is built on high-volume sales at competitive prices, buying and selling grocery and household stock in bulk rather than running a conventional supermarket-style operation, with a range that spans everyday grocery staples alongside non-food household items.

It serves households, traders and businesses that buy groceries and other consumer goods in bulk or at wholesale-oriented prices, from large families stocking up to small shop owners restocking their own shelves. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Pretoria, Advance Cash n Carry trades from 904 Haarlem Street in Hermanstad, Pretoria.

African Consulting Surveyors is a precision surveying and geospatial firm formed in 2000, providing airborne and mobile LiDAR mapping, large-format aerial photography and terrestrial 3D scanning. Its work supports the mining, process plant, transportation, energy, construction, commercial and water sectors with customised, fast-turnaround solutions.

The firm began as an engineering survey practice and says it has worked with some of the biggest mining companies in Africa, from greenfield projects through to mine closure. Its 3D scanning is used to obtain accurate, up-to-date as-built data for engineering functions. It suits mining, infrastructure and energy clients who need accurate survey data quickly, and its office is in Doornpoort, Pretoria.

Afrison LED is a South African manufacturer of industrial LED lighting and audio-visual solutions, designed for mines, factories, farms and ports. Its industrial range includes items in stock as well as made-to-order lines, and its commercial lighting is designed for public and commercial spaces. The company says its products are SABS certified and backed by local service and real warranties.

Beyond manufacturing, it offers lighting compliance consulting, on-site assessments for new and existing installations, audio-visual systems including digital signage and LED displays, generator supply and maintenance, and signal distribution design. Repairs can be booked through its website. It suits industrial operators and facility managers who need compliant, durable lighting and integrated systems supported locally, and the company is based on Cradock Avenue in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion.

Afrox Silvertondale is a branch of Afrox, South Africa's industrial-gas and welding-products supplier, operating from Silvertondale in Pretoria. The branch supplies industrial gases and welding-related products as part of Afrox's national network, drawing on a company whose business is built on gas supply for industry rather than retail-only trade.

It serves industrial, manufacturing, engineering and welding customers, along with other commercial clients that need a reliable source of gas and associated welding equipment and consumables for their operations. Afrox Silvertondale is listed as an industrial-gas supplier at 253 Dykor Road in Silvertondale, Pretoria, and functions as a branch outlet of the wider Afrox business rather than an independent operator.

Akarnia Hardware + Build is a home-improvement and construction-products retailer selling hardware, tools, lumber and building materials, paint, plumbing supplies, garden products, power tools, lighting and electrical products, security products, sealants and other DIY goods. It also supplies contractor-related products and runs its own delivery fleet across Gauteng rather than relying on third-party couriers.

It serves DIY customers and homeowners working on their own projects as well as contractors and construction professionals needing trade-level supply. Established in 2016 and family-owned, Akarnia operates four retail stores across Centurion and Pretoria North, including this branch on Botha Avenue in Kloofsig, Centurion, and suits customers who want hardware and building supplies with delivery included.

Alternative Finance Group, known as AFG, is a non-bank finance provider in Centurion offering fast, flexible business funding across South Africa. Its solutions include asset-backed lending, purchase order finance, invoice discounting and property bridging, with amounts of up to R50 million, and the group says it has supported more than 1,295 businesses and funded more than R2.3 billion.

Each product has its own criteria. Asset-backed lending requires an annual turnover of about R1 million and a 2:1 asset-to-loan ratio, invoice discounting requires an approved invoice from a client, and purchase order finance requires a verified government purchase order with a profit margin of at least 30 percent. Applications are completed online, after which a specialist makes contact. It suits established businesses with government or corporate contracts or property to bridge, and the office is in Centurion Gate Office Park on Akkerboom Street.

AMC Consultants is a global mining consultancy with a Centurion office, providing geological, geotechnical, metallurgical and mining engineering services to the resources sector. Its services cover pre-feasibility and feasibility studies, caving, engineering services and predictive geometallurgy, alongside advisory work such as strategy optimisation and performance diagnostics for mining businesses.

The firm says it has delivered data-driven mining solutions to more than 1,800 clients and that it is now part of AFRY, which adds a wider footprint across Australia, Canada, South Africa and the UK. The company expects the partnership to let it deliver larger, more complex projects across the mining lifecycle. It suits mining companies that need technical studies or advice at any stage, and the office is at Byls Bridge Office Park in Doringkloof, Centurion.

The ARC-Onderstepoort Veterinary Institute is the veterinary research campus of the Agricultural Research Council, a flagship campus of the ARC on Old Soutpan Road in Pretoria. It has a long tradition of veterinary research dating back to its founding in 1908 and is recognised internationally as a centre of excellence for animal health and welfare.

The campus develops vaccines and diagnostic tests using molecular techniques, produces vaccines against diseases such as foot-and-mouth disease and tick-borne diseases, and provides veterinary diagnostic services. It works as a collaborating centre for the World Organisation for Animal Health and the FAO in animal disease surveillance, control and emergency preparedness across Africa. It suits veterinary services and animal-health bodies that rely on its diagnostics, vaccines and surveillance support.

Ariston South Africa, trading as Ariston Thermo South Africa, manufactures and supplies domestic water-heating solutions, including electric water heaters, solar geysers and thermal collectors, and gas or instant water heaters, with high-efficiency electric and solar systems among its ranges. The business is the successor to Heat Tech Geysers, carrying that history into its current product line.

It serves households, professional installers and plumbers who need geysers, solar water heaters or heat pumps for domestic hot-water systems, supplying both the retail and installation side of the market. Ariston South Africa is based at 294 Barolong Street in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, and suits customers replacing or upgrading a home's water-heating system.

The Auditor-General South Africa is the country's constitutional supreme audit institution, established as a Chapter 9 institution under the Constitution. It conducts public-sector audits and reports on how government institutions use and manage public resources, operating under the authority of the Constitution and the Public Audit Act.

It serves national, provincial and local government institutions, along with other public-sector entities that fall under its statutory auditing mandate, by holding them to account for public money through its audit findings. The Auditor-General's head office is at 4 Daventry Street in Lynnwood Bridge Office Park, Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria, and its work underpins public accountability across South Africa's government structures.

Auto Pedigree Centurion is a used-car dealership selling pre-owned passenger vehicles and bakkies, with current stock drawn from a range of manufacturers and body types rather than a single brand. Vehicles are bought, sold and traded through the branch as part of Auto Pedigree's wider dealer network.

It serves customers in Centurion and the surrounding Pretoria area who are looking to buy a used car or bakkie, whether replacing a family vehicle or adding a second car. The branch, at the corner of Hendrik Verwoerd Drive and Galway Avenue in Hennopspark, Centurion, typically carries around 18 vehicles in stock, backed by a national network of more than 3,000 vehicles across Auto Pedigree's branches.
